Trump's Bombardier Jet Ban Threat Sparks Worker Fears

US President Donald Trump has threatened to ban aircraft manufactured by Canadian company Bombardier from entering the United States. This threat has caused significant concern among workers at Bombardier's facilities in the US, who fear potential job losses. The ban is reportedly linked to trade disputes, with Trump having previously accused Bombardier of "dumping" its aircraft into the US market. Workers expressed anxiety about their livelihoods and the future of the company's US operations.
